Fixture: 52_vardct_mixed_gray_128x128_filters_d1.jxl
128x128 greyscale, VarDCT lossy, default restoration filters, d=1.0

Purpose
-------
Same source and distance as 50, but restoration filters left at cjxl's
default (encoder chooses gaborish; EPF runs at its default strength). See
50's sidecar for the source recipe and general rationale. This fixture
exists to gate 8E's restoration-filter work as a delta against 50: same
content, same distance, filters on instead of off.

Filters left at default, so per 18181-3 Annex A Table A.1 this is the wider
class:

    Part 3 error class:  peak <= 0.06,  RMSE <= 0.02   (with filters)

    Shape (1, 128, 128, 1) little-endian f32, per 18181-3 4.1.2. Readable
    with jpxl_conformance::FloatImage::from_npy.
    Regenerable at any time from the fixture with the pinned djxl build
    (decode is deterministic per libjxl revision, see PINNED_REVISIONS.txt).

cjxl/djxl are used strictly as BLACK BOXES: they emit/consume conformant
streams for JPXL to parse. libjxl's source is never read. If a rebuild at a
different libjxl revision changes these digests, that is the point of
recording them -- do not silently update them; note the revision change.
